data.title: 欧根亲王 · 海景阳台的夜风回首
data.description: 度假套房的海景玻璃露台上，微咸湿润的夜风拂动纱帘。欧根身穿明艳的比基尼，背倚着晶莹剔透的玻璃护栏。手中轻晃着高脚红酒杯，红色挑染随风掠过锁骨。她微微仰头回首，嘴角含着三分醉意与七分挑逗，在星海与浪花拍打声中勾人心魄。
data.location: luxurious oceanfront suite balcony under moonlight and crashing waves
data.action: leaning back against glass balcony railing overlooking ocean, stylish bikini, holding wine glass, night wind blowing twintails, alluring sultry expression looking at viewer
data.lighting: ambient starlight and soft luxury patio floor downlights
data.mood: breathtaking coastal elegance, intoxicating summer romance
data.promptProse: Leaning back against a glass resort balcony railing overlooking the moonlit ocean, Prinz Eugen holds a delicate wine glass. Wearing a chic bikini, her hair flutters in the sea breeze as she looks over her shoulder with a seductive smile.
data.animaCaption: Prinz Eugen in a bikini holding a wine glass on a moonlit resort balcony above the sea.
data.identityProseOverride: Prinz Eugen from Azur Lane, with ash grey hair in elegant twin braids with a striking crimson streak, alluring amber eyes, and a signature beauty mark beneath her right eye.
